'''Cragolin''' is a [[Rock]] type [[Specialist]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Drilleroo]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Borelord]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "To Cragolin, digging tunnels is nothing less than reshaping the world. Not everyone agrees, especially when those tunnels cut right through [[Watchroo]] homes."

Cragolin is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
TBA

== Evolution Trial ==
Cragolin's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Borelord]] you need to complete the following task:

* Feed Cragolin to increase stats 3 times.
* Play [[Treasure Hunt]] (dig up 70 treasure) or [[Cozy Farm]] (use fertilizer x4200).

== Trivia ==

* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "For Cragolin, burrowing is like swimming in soil. [[Gopher]] makes a great underground neighbor, though their overlapping tunnels often spark quarrels."
